# openwrt_dhcp_host (Resource)

Manages a static DHCP host reservation in OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IP address to assign (e.g., '192.168.1.100').
- `mac` (List of String) MAC addresses to match (e.g., ['00:11:22:33:44:55']).
- `name` (String) Hostname for the DHCP reservation.

### Optional

- `leasetime` (String) Lease time override (e.g., '12h', 'infinite').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: dhcp/<host_name>.
